The roles

who we're after

Fun, passionate, and properly good with people

Everything we serve is made here, so there's a craft to learn. But the bit we can't teach is the bit we care most about: how you make people feel when they walk through the door.

  • Fun and full of energy, people should leave smiling
  • Passionate about what we make and what we serve
  • Reliable, on time and ready for a busy one
  • Proud of the details, every scoop, every counter
  • 16 or over and eligible to work in the UK

the fun bit

Show us your scoop

Every application includes a short video, about a minute, so we get to meet the real you before we meet you. Film it on your phone; we're not marking the camerawork. Just answer these three:

1

Why should we hire you?

2

What makes you unique compared to other applicants?

3

If you were serving gelato, how would you bring fun and energy to the experience?

Going for Assistant Manager? Say so at the very beginning of your video so we know to watch it with that in mind.

You'll upload the video and your CV inside the form, so have both to hand before you start. Files go through Google, so you'll need to be signed in to a Google account.

easy as one, two, scoop

How to apply

Four steps from here to behind the counter.

1

Get your bits ready

Your CV, and a video of about a minute answering the three questions above.

2

Fill in the form

Your details, the role you're after, when you're free and when you could start.

3

We'll be in touch

We read every application. If it looks like a fit, we'll get in contact.

4

Come and meet us

Pop into the parlour so we can meet properly, show you around and answer your questions.
